mechanism: Clotrimazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, reducing conversion of clopidogrel prodrug to its active metabolite, thereby decreasing antiplatelet efficacy.
action: Consider alternative antifungal agent (e.g., fluconazole or terbinafine) or monitor for reduced clopidogrel effectiveness; ensure adequate antiplatelet effect in patients with acute coronary syndrome or stent placement.
